GOAL: score behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts against rubric-2026-10-v1.
READ: frozen bundle 049d663f765dd9c6, E1-E13, plus the scope contract and experiment policy.
OBSERVED: E5 measures successor-entropy spread (top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543); E11 measures baseline same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067; E12/E13 put log_a and exp at the anchor inside the residual primitive.
REASONING: behaviour 4, geometry 3, novelty 3, downstream 3, falsifiability 4, implementability 4, exploration 4. The decisive weakness is that per-item tangent frames are compared to one shared codebook without parallel transport; the 0.5 s clamp is dimensionally ambiguous.
EVIDENCE: E1 E2 E3 E5 E10 E11 E12 E13.
OPEN: the write-up does not state the three switch values explicitly, and the fraction of empty/clamped anchors is unmeasured.

SCORE: behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts | behavior_evidence=4 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=4 | implementability=4 | exploration_value=4
SCOPE: behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts | IN_SCOPE | Behaviour is the top-8 weighted successor Karcher mean (E1-E3), the curved primitive is log_a and exp at the anchor and at every reconstructed point (E12-E13), the anchor enters the code-producing map itself, and the three switches exist: a_i=0 removes behaviour, Euclidean exp/log removes curvature, both-off is the baseline quantizer; the specification text never writes these switch values down.
EVIDENCE: behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts | E1 E2 E3 E5 E10 E11 E12 E13
OBJECTION: behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts | A per-item anchor defines a different tangent frame at every item, yet the quantizer compares those tangent vectors to one shared codebook C_l with no parallel transport; log_{a_i} is only a local chart, so equal code tuples do not mean comparable displacements and the codebook gradients mix incomparable frames. The 0.5 s anchor clamp is also dimensionally ambiguous because the ball radius is 1 while s is a tangent-space scale.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts | On the unit Poincare disk take a1=(0.9,0) and a2=(-0.9,0) and the same tangent vector v=(0.1,0). exp_{a1}(v) lies near the right boundary and exp_{a2}(v) near the left boundary, so both items receive the same level-1 code while their hyperbolic distance is O(1); a per-item Euclidean origin shift has no such ambiguity because R^d tangent spaces are canonically identified by translation.
RATIONALE: behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts | Behaviour 4: E5 measures the successor-entropy spread and E11 measures the weak baseline prefix agreement, so the SID hypothesis has measured headroom, but the specific claim that equal displacement from a personal anchor captures adjacency is not itself measured. Geometry 3: the curved maps are genuinely inside the residual primitive, yet a per-item Euclidean origin shift is a natural matched control that reproduces the relative-displacement idea to first order, and the non-commutativity of the chart is the only argued extra. Novelty 3: base-point selection is a different coupling position from the ledger's tangent_successor_residual and successor_geodesic_coarse, but the proposal does not argue against those measured entries. Downstream 3: the observables are concrete, yet relative charts can raise tuple collisions and the chain does not address that. Falsifiability 4: behaviour-off, geometry-off and both-off are named with diagnostics and a criterion. Implementability 4: differentiable with stop-gradient anchors, clamped radius, frozen scale and a plausible 1.05x cost; the tangent-frame comparability issue is a correctness risk, not a missing implementation. Exploration 4. Uncertainty is the single-run seed noise plus anchor stability; UNKNOWN is the fraction of items whose anchor is empty or clamped, resolvable by one pass over the frozen transition table and the epoch-0 anchor table.

GOAL: score BRANCHCURV-SID against rubric-2026-10-v1.
READ: frozen bundle 793ad1b98a447ed6, E1-E14, scope contract.
OBSERVED: E5 gives a strong hub/leaf entropy stratification; E12/E13 make kappa_k per code and put it in the assignment distance; E14 is the logit equation.
REASONING: behaviour 4, geometry 3, novelty 3, downstream 3, falsifiability 2, implementability 2, exploration 3. The decisive defect is a curvature-map mismatch that can make d_{kappa_k} undefined.
EVIDENCE: E1 E2 E3 E5 E10 E12 E13 E14.
OPEN: per-code entropy spread and the soft-assignment commitment under epoch-0 assignments are unmeasured.

SCORE: BRANCHCURV-SID | behavior_evidence=4 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=2 | implementability=2 | exploration_value=3
SCOPE: BRANCHCURV-SID | IN_SCOPE | Behaviour sets H_k and kappa_k and kappa_k enters the nearest-code distance and the soft assignment, so the pathway is connected; the neutral kappa_k=constant and Euclidean limit are the switches, but they are not written down, so the three-comparison statement is missing from the text.
EVIDENCE: BRANCHCURV-SID | E1 E2 E3 E5 E10 E12 E13 E14
OBJECTION: BRANCHCURV-SID | u_i is built in the k0 ball but scored with d_{kappa_k} in the kappa_k ball; the denominator 1 - kappa_k||u_i||^2 is not guaranteed positive and no rescaling of u_i into the kappa_k ball is specified. The softmax assignment with tau fixed to the epoch-0 median distance also makes the 256 logits nearly uniform, so the quantizer may never commit.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: BRANCHCURV-SID | With k0=1, an item whose u_i has ||u_i||^2=0.9, and a code with kappa_k=4, the factor is 1-4(0.9)=-2.6; the arcosh argument can fall below 1 or the denominator changes sign, so the distance is undefined for a legal item-code pair and the level assignment breaks.
RATIONALE: BRANCHCURV-SID | Behaviour 4: E5 shows the hub/leaf spread with support 2.8 vs 44.3 and E10 documents coverage. Geometry 3: per-code curvature is a real curved object, but a per-code monotone rescaling of distance is close to a Euclidean reweighting and the claim that varied curvature buys resolution is not established. Novelty 3: per-code rather than per-item curvature, distinct from the ledger but a routine variation on the behaviour-sets-the-metric family. Downstream 3: entropy and prefix hit-rate are named, but near-uniform soft assignment can erase the token contrast the chain needs. Falsifiability 2: only the on-arm, no named off-arms or matched controls. Implementability 2: the curvature-ball mismatch needs a renormalisation that is not specified, and the one-off tau is a hidden dependence. Exploration 3. UNKNOWN is the per-code entropy spread under epoch-0 assignments; the bounded check is to compute H_k for the 256 level-1 codes.

GOAL: score SUCC-TAN-RQ against rubric-2026-10-v1.
READ: frozen bundle d05a69f10df0b176, E1-E14, and ledger entries E6.
OBSERVED: E6 contains tangent_successor_residual at recall 0.055 with T1 NLL 4.00, and successor_geodesic_coarse at 0.055; both are direct predecessors of this proposal. E5 measures successor concentration.
REASONING: behaviour 3, geometry 2, novelty 2, downstream 3, falsifiability 2, implementability 3, exploration 2. The additive successor-mean tangent vanishes exactly for symmetric successors and is noise-amplified for near-symmetric ones.
EVIDENCE: E1 E2 E3 E5 E6 E10 E12 E13 E14.
OPEN: the cancellation frequency is unmeasured.

SCORE: SUCC-TAN-RQ | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=2 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=2 | implementability=3 | exploration_value=2
SCOPE: SUCC-TAN-RQ | IN_SCOPE | The base shift is inside the quantizer and the behaviour term shares u_hat with the fidelity term, so removing eta or replacing the maps with Euclidean ones changes the code chain; the three switch values are implicit (eta=0, Euclidean maps) and not stated.
EVIDENCE: SUCC-TAN-RQ | E1 E2 E3 E5 E6 E10 E12 E13 E14
OBJECTION: SUCC-TAN-RQ | This is a near-repeat of the ledger's tangent_successor_residual (E6 recall 0.055, T1 NLL 4.00): both shift the level-1 base along the mean successor tangent and then quantize. The eta derivation is also unstable: dividing by median||t_i|| scales every item to one code spacing, so items whose successor mean cancels receive a full-size shift in a noise direction.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: SUCC-TAN-RQ | An item with two equally frequent successors placed symmetrically about u_i has log u_j1 - log u_i = -(log u_j2 - log u_i), so t_i=0 exactly and the behaviour shift vanishes; with a 51/49 split the same item receives a one-code-spacing shift along an almost arbitrary direction, so the mechanism is silent on the symmetric case and noise-driven on the near-symmetric case.
RATIONALE: SUCC-TAN-RQ | Behaviour 3: E5 shows successor concentration and direction exists, but the claim that residuals destroy direction is inferred, not measured. Geometry 2: exp/log is used, but a Euclidean tangent shift followed by a Euclidean residual reproduces the first-order behaviour, and E6 already shows l1_br_euclid at 0.06207 above the hyperbolic successors at 0.055. Novelty 2: a near-repeat not argued against the ledger. Downstream 3. Falsifiability 2: no named controls. Implementability 3: eta is derived, but boundary blow-up and the balance of the two reconstruction terms are unguarded. Exploration 2. UNKNOWN: the fraction of items with ||t_i|| below 10 percent of the median; the bounded check is one pass over the frozen successor table.

FINAL ANSWER (complete, all nine proposal blocks).
1 behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts 4/3/3/3/4/4/4 IN_SCOPE.
2 BRANCHCURV-SID 4/3/3/3/2/2/3 IN_SCOPE (switches implicit).
3 SUCC-TAN-RQ 3/2/2/3/2/3/2 IN_SCOPE (near-repeat of tangent_successor_residual).
4 GEOPFX-SID 3/3/4/3/2/3/4 IN_SCOPE.
5 GEO-SHELL-RQ 3/2/4/2/2/2/4 IN_SCOPE (radius formula inverted vs hypothesis; delta undefined).
6 GYRO-TARGET-RQ 3/3/4/3/2/4/3 IN_SCOPE.
7 KAPPA_BRANCH 4/3/4/4/2/3/4 IN_SCOPE (curvature-ball denominator can go negative).
8 GEO_REPAIR 2/2/3/3/2/3/3 OUT_OF_SCOPE (post-hoc repair on unchanged quantizer; collision rate unmeasured).
9 LORENTZ_CONE_RQ 4/4/4/4/3/3/4 IN_SCOPE (future-cone order infeasible on reciprocal transitions).
Key objections: (1) per-item tangent frames not comparable without parallel transport; (2) u_i at k0 scored in kappa_k ball gives negative denominator; (3) successor mean cancels for symmetric successors; (4) Euclidean space does have betweenness, and the term is inert at LCP=0; (5) root B=N maps to rho=0 and leaf B=1 to the boundary, opposite of the stated hypothesis; (6) deterministic-successor items shift halfway to successor and can collide; (7) per-pair kbar with points from different curvature maps is undefined at ||p||^2>1/kbar; (8) 256^3 possible full SIDs can make collision set empty; (9) i->j and j->i cannot both be timelike future. No recall prediction, no ranking. Single-run seed noise is part of every uncertainty.

CHECK 1/8 idea=behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts
GOAL: decide scope and score the chart-relative geodesic RQ against the frozen bundle.
READ: bundle 049d663f765dd9c6 (E5 entropy strata, E6 beam survival, E8 K-cluster ceiling, E11 0.0907 vs 0.067, E12/E13 Poincare ops), rubric-2026-10-v1.
OBSERVED: behaviour is a real top-8 successor statistic but E8 caps first-level behavioural agreement at 0.0822 for K=256 vs a 0.0907 measured baseline, and E6 shows depth-1 gold-prefix survival already 1.000; points satisfy ||p||<=s with anchors clamped to 0.5s, so the ball is near-Euclidean where the data live.
REASONING: in scope (behaviour picks the gauge, geometry builds the code), but curvature gain is bounded and the mechanism is a sibling of the already measured successor_geodesic_coarse (0.0550) and tangent_successor_residual (0.0550).
OPEN: median ||z_i|| is not in the bundle; a bounded check of median and p95 norm versus 1/sqrt(c) would decide whether curvature can bite at all.
BLOCK: behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts scored be3 gn3 nov2 dm3 fa3 im4 ev2.

CHECK 2/8 idea=BRANCHCURV-SID
GOAL: test whether per-code curvature is a geometric computation or a per-code bias.
READ: bundle 793ad1b98a447ed6 (E5, E8, E11, E12-E14 curvature and logits), rubric.
OBSERVED: l_ik = -d_{kappa_k}(u_i,e_k)^2/tau; for a fixed code kappa_k is a constant, and at small norm d_kappa^2 ~ 4||u-e||^2/((1-kappa||u||^2)(1-kappa||e||^2)) + O(r^4), i.e. a code-specific weight 1/(1-kappa_k||e_k||^2) times the Euclidean distance.
REASONING: the argmin is reproducible by a Euclidean quantizer with 256 free per-code logit offsets, so geometry necessity cannot exceed 2; entropy-to-curvature is measured at the item level (E5) but the per-code aggregation is unmeasured and self-referential; soft assignment changes quantizer semantics and the spec does not say how a soft q_i becomes a token.
OPEN: whether a frozen per-code curvature beats a learned per-code bias is UNKNOWN; a bounded check would fit both on one epoch of fixed assignments.
BLOCK: BRANCHCURV-SID scored be3 gn2 nov2 dm3 fa2 im3 ev2.

CHECK 3/8 idea=SUCC-TAN-RQ
GOAL: check the residual recursion and the ledger overlap.
READ: bundle d05a69f10df0b176 (E5, E6 tangent_successor_residual 0.0550, E12-E14).
OBSERVED: xi_1 = log_{e_c1}(b) - log_{e_c1}(e_c1) = log_{e_c1}(b) since log_x(x)=0, so b^2 = exp_{e_c1}(xi_1) = b^1 and c_2 = c_1; by induction every level repeats c_1 and every SID is (c1,c1,c1).
REASONING: as written the chain carries no residual, a one-line but genuine redesign is needed; E6 already contains tangent_successor_residual at 0.0550 with prefix survival 0.643/0.180/0.090/0.073, worse than l1_br_euclid (1.000/0.829/0.161) at depths 1-3.
OPEN: whether the measured ledger entry is the same construction cannot be resolved from the bundle text.
BLOCK: SUCC-TAN-RQ scored be3 gn2 nov1 dm2 fa3 im2 ev1.

CHECK 4/8 idea=GEOPFX-SID
GOAL: test the reach of the geodesic-segment alignment term.
READ: bundle 50a5519306326a02 (E2 sampling of transitions, E6, E11, E12-E14).
OBSERVED: pairs with LCP=0 are skipped; E11 measures same-first-prefix 0.0907 against a 0.067 permuted null, so at least 90.9% of sampled transition pairs push zero gradient; w_ij is a raw count and the term weight is fixed at 1.
REASONING: the surviving gradient is a self-selected minority, and one prefix anchor is the target of many pairs with different geodesics, so contributions cancel; the betweenness premise is unmeasured (E6 shows prefix survival collapse, not that prefixes are off-path).
OPEN: whether the count-weighted term dominates the baseline loss is UNKNOWN; a bounded check is to print the ratio L_geo / L_rec at step 0 before training.
BLOCK: GEOPFX-SID scored be2 gn2 nov2 dm3 fa2 im3 ev3.

CHECK 5/8 idea=GEO-SHELL-RQ
GOAL: test the radius formula against the stated hypothesis and the curved content of the shell projection.
READ: bundle 30c1719765864a9d (E5, E9 cohort signal, E12-E15 including a specified matched Euclidean control).
OBSERVED: r_lg = (N-B_g)/(N+B_g) gives r ~ 1 for a leaf (B=1) and r -> 0 for the root (B=N), so broad communities get small radii, the inverse of "broad behaviour communities will occupy large-radius shells"; the diameter from the origin through m is the Euclidean segment, so geodesic projection onto a shell is an exactly Euclidean radial rescale.
REASONING: internal direction contradiction plus a Euclidean-reproducible projection step; Stage 3 sees only token ids, so the only live channel is the induced partition; the recursive Leiden/normalised-cut schedule and the projection band delta are unspecified constants (delta would be a tuned constant, against policy).
OPEN: whether the shell radii stay inside the data support (||p||<=s) is not answerable from the bundle.
BLOCK: GEO-SHELL-RQ scored be3 gn3 nov3 dm2 fa3 im2 ev3.

CHECK 6/8 idea=GYRO-TARGET-RQ
GOAL: judge the target-reshaping coupling and its collision side effect.
READ: bundle fff91d61a8162b9b (E5 top-1 mass by bin, E9 0.9291 cohort sharing, E15 matched control, E16 log/exp round-trip PASS).
OBSERVED: eta_i = c_i/(1+c_i) is parameterised by the concentration E5 measures per bin (0.4375 down to 0.0543 with item counts and support); b_i uses sg(p_j) refreshed per epoch, so the map is a fixed-point iteration; S_i empty leaves eta_i and the mean undefined.
REASONING: best-grounded behaviour signal of the set because the parameter is a directly measured per-item statistic with coverage; the geometry is a genuine geodesic interpolation (arcs, not lerp) but its added value over a Euclidean interpolation is not argued; the role-merging premise buys prefix predictability by spending item-level discriminability, which is exactly what recall@10 must resolve.
OPEN: the fraction of item pairs that would become exact target twins under b_i is not measured; a bounded check is the collision count of b_i under a 3-level quantizer at epoch 0.
BLOCK: GYRO-TARGET-RQ scored be4 gn3 nov3 dm3 fa3 im3 ev4.

CHECK 7/8 idea=KAPPA_BRANCH
GOAL: test whether per-item curvature changes capacity or only rescales distances.
READ: bundle c671300940bb9492 (E5, E6 successor_entropy 0.0512, E8 capacity ceiling, E11, E12-E14).
OBSERVED: kappa_i in [1,2] is a monotone rescaling; the level-1 vocabulary stays at 256 codes; E8 measures the ceiling of a 256-cell behavioural partition at 0.0822 of canonical pairs, below the 0.0907 measured baseline same-prefix rate; at small norm d_kappa^2 factorises into a Euclidean distance times kappa-dependent code factors.
REASONING: "more curvature buys separation per bit" conflates metric separation with code capacity; the entropy statistic itself is well measured (E5, support and distinct-successor counts), and the ledger already records successor_entropy at 0.0512, a measured negative in this family.
OPEN: whether the occupancy gap the hypothesis names can appear at fixed 256 codes is UNKNOWN; a bounded check is the level-1 occupancy entropy at epoch 0 under kappa0 vs kappa_i.
BLOCK: KAPPA_BRANCH scored be3 gn2 nov2 dm3 fa2 im3 ev2.

CHECK 8/8 idea=GEO_REPAIR
GOAL: test whether the collision cap it repairs is measured and whether the repair keeps the SID protocol intact.
READ: bundle a56f1901261e9aa4 (E6 category shares, E11, E12-E15).
OBSERVED: no duplicate-tuple count exists in the bundle; E6 attributes misses to sid_absent_from_beams 53,546/57,439 = 93.2% and only 1,210/57,439 = 2.1% to generation-then-drop; the fallback to level 2 changes SID length and breaks the fixed three-token vocabulary; RQ-VAE codes have no capacity limit, so "free capacity" is undefined.
REASONING: the measured failure mode is beam absence, not collision ambiguity, so the behaviour problem is high-risk and unmeasured; for small-norm codebooks d_P is monotone in the Euclidean distance so the geometric tie-break is Euclidean-reproducible; the coupling is thin because the quantizer, codebook and encoder are untouched.
OPEN: the actual collision rate is UNKNOWN; one bounded check (duplicate item_sids count from the frozen SID table) would decide whether the premise has any support.
BLOCK: GEO_REPAIR scored be2 gn2 nov2 dm2 fa2 im2 ev3.

CHECK 9/9 idea=LORENTZ_CONE_RQ
GOAL: test the M_l construction, the term scale and whether residual levels can be cone-ordered.
READ: bundle bd8bbcbdc448cf32 (E5, E7 per-position NLL l1_br T4 9.03, E10, E12-E14).
OBSERVED: M_l indexes pairs of level-l codebook centroids yet is "built once from the Stage-2 training split" before any centroid exists and is never refreshed; the spec sums over all 256x256 code pairs per level while the cost section charges 3x2048 sampled hinge evaluations; with c=1, mean_positive_M~5 the normalised sum is O(10^3) against a reconstruction loss of O(1).
REASONING: the matrix cannot exist as specified, the scale factor does not balance the terms, and a level-l residual centroid is an offset in the tangent frame of the item's own chosen code, not a child of a global e_{l-1}, so the cone order constrains a relation the quantizer does not have; the Lorentz formalism itself is distinct and the order hypothesis is genuinely new here.
OPEN: whether order information is recoverable from residue alone is the substantive question the run would answer.
BLOCK: LORENTZ_CONE_RQ scored be3 gn3 nov3 dm2 fa2 im2 ev4.

FINAL (complete answer printed in the response; record compacted to fit the 4000-char cap)
SCORE: behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=2 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=4 | exploration_value=2 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E6 E8 E10 E11 E12 E13
SCORE: BRANCHCURV-SID | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=2 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=2 | implementability=3 | exploration_value=2 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E8 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14
SCORE: SUCC-TAN-RQ | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=1 | downstream_mechanism=2 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=2 | exploration_value=1 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E6 E7 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14
SCORE: GEOPFX-SID | behavior_evidence=2 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=2 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=2 | implementability=3 | exploration_value=3 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E6 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14
SCORE: GEO-SHELL-RQ | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=2 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=2 | exploration_value=3 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E9 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15
SCORE: GYRO-TARGET-RQ | behavior_evidence=4 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=3 | implementability=3 | exploration_value=4 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E9 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15 E16
SCORE: KAPPA_BRANCH | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=2 | downstream_mechanism=3 | falsifiability=2 | implementability=3 | exploration_value=2 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E6 E8 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14
SCORE: GEO_REPAIR | behavior_evidence=2 | geometry_necessity=2 | novelty=2 | downstream_mechanism=2 | falsifiability=2 | implementability=2 | exploration_value=3 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E6 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15
SCORE: LORENTZ_CONE_RQ | behavior_evidence=3 | geometry_necessity=3 | novelty=3 | downstream_mechanism=2 | falsifiability=2 | implementability=2 | exploration_value=4 | IN_SCOPE | E4 E5 E7 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14
KEY CROSS-CUTTING OBSERVATIONS: all nine are in scope, four of them only marginally (GEO_REPAIR, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ, GEOPFX-SID, GEO-SHELL-RQ: the behavioural switch or the curved operation sits at the edge of the core computation rather than inside it). Decisive objections, each with a counterexample in the printed answer: near-origin degeneracy of a c=1 ball against data confined to ||p||<=s (charts, KAPPA_BRANCH, GEO_REPAIR); per-code curvature as a per-code logit bias (BRANCHCURV-SID); a residual recursion that is the identity because log_x(x)=0 (SUCC-TAN-RQ); LCP=0 skipping >=90.9% of pairs plus cancelling anchor gradients (GEOPFX-SID); an inverted radius formula (GEO-SHELL-RQ); a fixed-point target with twinning (GYRO-TARGET-RQ); an M_l that indexes centroids that do not exist yet and a ~10^3 scale mismatch (LORENTZ_CONE_RQ). SUCC-TAN-RQ also duplicates the measured tangent_successor_residual family (E6 0.0550). GYRO-TARGET-RQ and LORENTZ_CONE_RQ have the highest exploration value; GEO-SHELL-RQ uniquely ships an explicit matched Euclidean control (E15). No ranking was made and no Recall@10 was predicted.
